judged_text: This unrelated handler inverts the billing flag condition: the old code set the organization slug only when team billing was disabled (`...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })`), the new code sets it only when enabled (`...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`), while the requestedSlug line on the next line keeps the original `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` condition — a silent objective change smuggled into a destinationCalendar PR. On deployments where IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED is false (e.g., self-hosting without Stripe), newly created organizations stop getting their slug written at creation, breaking org URL/slug reservation until manually repaired; on billing-enabled deployments the slug is now written immediately, changing the paid signup flow — neither change is part of the accepted PR objective.
